CREATE TABLE issuers(organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,country_code TEXT NOT NULL,city TEXT NOT NULL,street TEXT NOT NULL,county TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(county IN('RO-AB','RO-AR','RO-AG','RO-BC','RO-BH','RO-BN','RO-BR','RO-BT','RO-BV','RO-B','RO-BZ','RO-CS','RO-CL','RO-CJ','RO-CT','RO-CV','RO-DB','RO-DJ','RO-GL','RO-GR','RO-GJ','RO-HR','RO-HD','RO-IL','RO-IS','RO-IF','RO-MM','RO-MH','RO-MS','RO-NT','RO-OT','RO-PH','RO-SM','RO-SJ','RO-SB','RO-SV','RO-TR','RO-TM','RO-TL','RO-VS','RO-VL','RO-VN')),sector INTEGER,postal_code TEXT,default_currency TEXT NOT NULL,default_payment_term_days INTEGER NOT NULL,branding TEXT CHECK(branding IS NULL OR json_valid(branding)),legal_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(legal_form IN('srl','pfa')),trade_registry_number TEXT NOT NULL,iban TEXT NOT NULL,bank_name TEXT NOT NULL,social_capital TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK((county='RO-B' AND sector IS NOT NULL AND sector BETWEEN 1 AND 6)OR(county!='RO-B' AND sector IS NULL)))STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status!='draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status!='draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_series WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND document_type='invoice' AND series=NEW.series)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice document series is not configured');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_update BEFORE UPDATE OF organization_id,series ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice draft series is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid draft source');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_source_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid draft source');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_bucharest_sector_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NEW.customer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.customer_sector IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bucharest sector is required');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_bucharest_sector_update BEFORE UPDATE OF customer_county,customer_sector ON invoice_drafts WHEN NEW.customer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.customer_sector IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bucharest sector is required');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_seal_only BEFORE UPDATE OF sealed ON proformas WHEN OLD.sealed=1 OR NEW.sealed!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_content_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id,source_draft_id,organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number,issue_date,due_date,issued_at,currency,issuer_legal_name,issuer_tax_identifier,issuer_country_code,issuer_city,issuer_street,issuer_county,issuer_sector,issuer_postal_code,issuer_legal_form,issuer_trade_registry_number,issuer_iban,issuer_bank_name,issuer_social_capital,issuer_vat_registered,issuer_branding,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_sector,customer_postal_code,customer_vat_registered,total_excluding_tax,tax_total,total_including_tax,notes ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proformas WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid proforma source');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma source is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_actor_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_id ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma actor is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_bucharest_sector_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proformas WHEN(NEW.issuer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.issuer_sector IS NULL)OR(NEW.customer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.customer_sector IS NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bucharest sector is required');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_lineage_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN(NEW.draft_id IS NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas p WHERE p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND p.sealed=1)))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid invoice proforma lineage');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id,draft_id,source_proforma_id,organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number,issue_date,due_date,issued_at,currency,issuer_legal_name,issuer_tax_identifier,issuer_country_code,issuer_city,issuer_street,issuer_county,issuer_sector,issuer_postal_code,issuer_legal_form,issuer_trade_registry_number,issuer_iban,issuer_bank_name,issuer_social_capital,issuer_vat_registered,issuer_branding,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_sector,customer_postal_code,customer_vat_registered,total_excluding_tax,tax_total,total_including_tax,notes ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable except e_factura_status');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid invoice source');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice source is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_actor_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_id ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice actor is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_bucharest_sector_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN(NEW.issuer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.issuer_sector IS NULL)OR(NEW.customer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.customer_sector IS NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bucharest sector is required');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON correction_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction documents are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON correction_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction documents are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON correction_documents WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid correction source');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_actor_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_id ON correction_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction actor is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_bucharest_sector_insert BEFORE INSERT ON correction_documents WHEN(NEW.issuer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.issuer_sector IS NULL)OR(NEW.customer_county='RO-B' AND NEW.customer_sector IS NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bucharest sector is required');END
